comment: What each control of the emulated Thrustmaster devices does by default in a game, shown read-only on HOTAS Mapper's cards. Keys are the emulated device's controls (what the game sees), so they stay valid however the real stick is remapped. Sections: stick = T.16000M, throttle = TWCS Throttle; each has buttons {"N": text}, hat {up/down/left/right: text}, axes {X/Y/RZ/SLIDER/...: text}. Set "verified" to true once checked against the game.

ac8-default.name: Ace Combat 8 (Default flight stick layout)
ac8-default.source: Buttons and hat: checked in game (Default flight stick layout, T.16000M as emulated by vkb-hotas), 2026-10-13. Axes: the game's own flight stick binding names. Buttons not listed had no recorded effect.
